checks.name: SQL Injection Detection
checks.description: Detects potential SQL injection vulnerabilities in database queries
checks.aiPrompt: Analyze the code for SQL injection patterns including unescaped user input in queries, dynamic SQL construction without parameterization, and lack of input validation.

checks.name: XSS Vulnerability Scan
checks.aiPrompt: Check for XSS vulnerabilities including unescaped HTML output, dangerous innerHTML usage, and missing Content Security Policy headers.

checks.name: PII Data Exposure
checks.description: Detects potential exposure of personally identifiable information
checks.aiPrompt: Scan for PII data exposure including SSN, credit cards, email addresses, phone numbers in logs, error messages, or client-side code.

checks.name: Code Complexity Analysis
checks.description: Analyzes code complexity and suggests refactoring
checks.aiPrompt: Evaluate cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, function length, and identify code that should be refactored for maintainability.

checks.name: API Rate Limiting
checks.description: Ensures proper rate limiting on API endpoints
checks.aiPrompt: Check that all API endpoints have appropriate rate limiting configured to prevent abuse and ensure service availability.

checks.name: Dependency Vulnerability Scan
checks.aiPrompt: Check all package dependencies against known vulnerability databases and flag outdated or vulnerable packages.

checks.name: GDPR Compliance Check
checks.aiPrompt: Verify GDPR compliance including data minimization, consent management, right to erasure implementation, and data processing agreements.

checks.name: Authentication Security
checks.aiPrompt: Analyze authentication mechanisms for weak password policies, missing MFA, insecure session management, and authorization bypass vulnerabilities.

checks.name: Performance Bottleneck Detection
checks.aiPrompt: Detect performance issues including N+1 queries, missing database indexes, inefficient algorithms, and memory leaks.

checks.name: Accessibility Standards
checks.aiPrompt: Check for accessibility issues including missing alt text, improper ARIA labels, keyboard navigation problems, and color contrast ratios.

templates.description: Healthcare data protection and privacy requirements
